_comment: Canonical listing store. A property is only status 'match' when MetroListPRO -- the official MetroList MLS site -- reports it For Sale with price, beds, full baths, acreage and pool all agreeing. Half baths never count toward the bath minimum; the IDX card rounds '2 full + 1 half' up to 3 and must not be trusted for that field. See README 'Verification gate'.

source.name: MetroListPRO (MetroList MLS of record), complete city enumeration
source.method: Enumerated every active and pending residential record in the three cities from the MetroListPRO city indexes and read each detail page's Status, Has a Pool, Lot Size in Acres and full-bath fields. No User-Agent spoofing: MetroListPRO answers an ordinary request, which is why this route is available to every run. Listings on another MLS were each confirmed against a live record named in foreignVerifiedBy.

dataQuality.coverageGap: Closed for this run. MetroListPRO enumerates MetroList only, so it is blind to a new listing on another MLS. The Coldwell Banker IDX cross-check (cb-crosscheck.py, plain request, no User-Agent spoof) carries other boards — it sees both known foreign listings, including 3538 Wildwood Ln, which MetroListPRO has never indexed — and it swept 408 records across the three cities this run, finding no qualifying candidate the board did not already track. It is a cross-check, not the board: it has no structured pool field, its bath count cannot resolve the 3-full-bath minimum, and it carries stale ACTIVE rows, so the MLS of record still decides every promotion.

idxCrossCheck.source: Coldwell Banker IDX (coldwellbanker.com), plain request, no UA spoof
idxCrossCheck.note: Carries non-MetroList boards, so unlike the MetroList mirrors it can see a new foreign-MLS listing. Pool is read from agent remarks and reviewed by hand; combined baths cannot resolve the 3-full-bath minimum; and this feed carries stale ACTIVE rows, so the MLS of record still decides.

dataQuality.multiUnitNote: 4800 Abbey Road (MLS 226133530) is on the board and reads 4 bedrooms / 4 full baths on MetroListPRO as of 2026-11-08, so the note this key used to carry — that its bed field read 3 and the enumerator therefore rejected it — no longer describes the record. The listing agent corrected it on 2026-11-06 (README "A near miss can become a match without anything new being listed"). The parser limitation it documented is NOT fixed and is the part worth keeping: this is a 2-houses-on-one-lot record with BOTH a populated whole-home bed field and a unit table, a shape classify() in mls-enumerate.py cannot see — it calls the record residential and qualifies() then judges it on the single bed field alone. It happens to pass now because the corrected field passes. The next record of this shape with an understated bed field will be rejected the same silent way.

poolFilteredCrossCheck.source: RealGeeks MetroList IDX (sellingnortherncalifornia.com), server-side pool filter, no UA spoof
poolFilteredCrossCheck.note: The only source this repo has found that filters on the MLS pool field server-side, so the candidate set arrives narrowed instead of being recovered from hundreds of detail reads. MetroList only, so it is blind to a foreign-MLS listing and does not close coverageGap; and its bath count is full + half combined, so it cannot resolve the 3-full-bath minimum. A cross-check, never the board.

listings.summary: Tucked away in Gold Hill on five golden acres, this single story ranch style home offers the kind of setting that makes you want to slow down and stay a while. Surrounded by rolling, oak studded terrain with beautiful valley and mountain views, the property combines privacy, space and effortless indoor/outdoor living. At the heart of the home, a vaulted great room is filled with natural light from a dramatic wall of arched windows that frame the landscape beyond. A gas stove adds warmth and character, while French doors open to the view over the deck. The kitchen features granite countertops, light wood cabinetry, a tumbled stone backsplash and gas cooktop, with an adjoining dining area. The spacious primary suite offers its own peaceful retreat, including a freestanding soaking tub beneath a sunlit corner window, separate walk-in shower and dual sink vanity. Three additional bedrooms include a Jack n Jill set up and one near the garage entry providing plenty of flexibility for family and/or guests. There is a dedicated office/den as well. Go outside and see how the property truly shines. A fenced in-ground pool and generous patio create a fabulous setting for summer afternoons and gatherings, all against a backdrop of sweeping valley, mountain views and sunsets. Natural landscaping, a welcoming covered front porch and five acres provide room to enjoy the outdoors without sacrificing privacy. There is plenty of room here to park all the things necessary to enjoy foothill life; boat, RV or trailers. The land is usable with lots of space to plant a garden and for the chicken coop and whatever else your heart desires. This serene property brings together comfortable single story living, beautiful surroundings and the space to enjoy it all right in the heart of Gold HIll.

rejected.reason: Outside the three target cities, and flagged rather than hidden because it fails only on that. Found on 2026-11-04 by a ZIP-keyed MLSListings sweep of 95682 — the Shingle Springs ZIP — which Cameron Park shares; the city-keyed enumerations this board runs on cannot see it. Verified on MetroListPRO (its board of record) the same day: Active, Has a Pool: Yes, Lot Size in Acres 5.9, SFR; MLSListings adds 4bd/3ba, 2,348 sqft, 7 days on market, gated Cameron Estates with ~500 ft of year-round Deer Creek frontage, two minutes from Hwy 50. It clears every other criterion — pool, 4bd, 3 full baths, 5.9 acres, $1,049,000. Say the word if Cameron Park counts and a future run can promote it to the board.

Surfaced on 2026-10-31 by the new Coldwell Banker IDX cross-check (cb-crosscheck.py), which reads it as ACTIVE at $1,050,000, 4bd, 5.0 acres, 101 days on market, with remarks describing a 'custom Milton Estates pool home'. It is a MetroList-format number and the feed files its photos under the MetroList bucket, so MetroListPRO is its own board of record — and MetroListPRO does not carry it: absent from the Shingle Springs active index (45 records) and the pending index (12), and /homes/2/6/x/226092223 serves the generic unknown-id page. The MLS-keyed realgeeks mirror 404s on it. A control listing (4071 Voyager Way, 226082753) resolves at both. Per README 'A 404 from a listing's own board is a departure; silence from a mirror is not', that is a departure and the IDX row is stale — the MLS of record wins. Recorded so a future run does not re-derive it; if MetroListPRO ever indexes it, treat it as a relist and verify before promoting.

Surfaced only by the Redfin county cross-check, not by the IDX feed or MetroListPRO — it is a For-Sale-by-Owner listing sourced from FSBO.com, so no MLS carries it. It came back with an empty LOT SIZE in the CSV (the trap the README warns about) and had to be read by hand: the detail page gives 0.79 acres, against a 2.5 acre minimum. 4bd/3ba, 2,444 sqft, no pool in the record or the description. Fails acreage.

Tracked as a relist after dropping from $1.5M; cut again to $1,150,000 (MetroListPRO list price on 2026-10-09, was $1,200,000). Resolved against MetroListPRO (MLS 226100125): Property Subtype is Triplex — multi-unit residential income, three dwellings (3bd/2ba main, 1bd/1ba ADU, studio pool house) on 10.27 acres. No single unit meets the 4BR/3BA minimum, and the MLS pool field reads No even though the remarks describe a 150,000-gallon pool. Re-confirmed Active, Triplex, Has a Pool: No on 2026-10-09. Retired from tracking; further price cuts do not change the subtype.

Went PENDING between the 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09 runs — MetroListPRO (MLS 226060031) reads Status: Pending at $1,100,000. 5 acres with a built-in sports pool, but 3 bd / 3 ba, under the 4BR minimum, so it was never a candidate; recorded here because the previous note asserted it was still actively listed.
